Title: 1. Beauty and the Beast
description: A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love.

Title: 2. Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

Title: 3. Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
description: Robin Hood decides to fight back as an outlaw when faced with the tyranny of the Sheriff of Nottingham.

Title: 4. The Silence of the Lambs
description: A young FBI cadet is aided by a manipulative cannibal killer in her pursuit of a madman who skins his victims.

Title: 5. City Slickers
description: On the verge of turning 40, an unhappy Manhattan yuppie is roped into joining his two friends on a cattle drive in the southwest.

Title: 6. Hook
description: When Captain James Hook kidnaps his children, an adult Peter Pan must return to Neverland and reclaim his youthful spirit in order to challenge his old enemy.

Title: 7. The Addams Family
description: Con artists plan to fleece an eccentric family using an accomplice who claims to be their long-lost uncle.

Title: 8. Sleeping with the Enemy
description: A librarian fakes her death to escape her abusive marriage and start a new life elsewhere, but her husband manages to track her down.

Title: 9. Father of the Bride
description: With his daughter's wedding approaching, a father finds himself reluctant to let her go.

Title: 10. The Naked Gun 2½: The Smell of Fear
description: Lieutenant Frank Drebin discovers that his ex-girlfriend's new beau is involved in a plot to kidnap a scientist who advocates solar energy.

Title: 11. Fried Green Tomatoes
description: Evelyn, an ordinary housewife, visits a nursing home and befriends the old lady Ninny. Together, they bond over stories from the past about two intrepid women of Whistle Stop Cafe.

Title: 12. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
description: The Turtles find out where the substance which made them mutate came from. Unfortunately, Shredder learns about it too, and uses it to his advantage, so the Turtles have to prove again who's the better ninja fighter.

Title: 13. Cape Fear
description: A convict systematically stalks the defense attorney who withheld evidence during his original trial fourteen years prior. The lawyer must protect his family from escalating psychological threats while navigating his own moral compromises.

Title: 14. Backdraft
description: Two feuding siblings carrying on a heroic family tradition as Chicago firefighters. But when a puzzling series of arson attacks is reported, they are forced to set aside their differences to solve the mystery surrounding these crimes.

Title: 15. Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
description: On the eve of retirement, Kirk and McCoy are charged with assassinating the Klingon High Chancellor and imprisoned. The Enterprise crew must help them escape to thwart a conspiracy aimed at sabotaging the last best hope for peace.

Title: 16. The Prince of Tides
description: Tom Wingo travels from South Carolina to New York City after his twin sister, Savannah, attempts suicide.

Title: 17. JFK
description: New Orleans District Attorney Jim Garrison discovers there's more to the Kennedy assassination than the official story.

Title: 18. Hot Shots!
description: A parody of Top Gun (1986) in which a talented but unstable fighter pilot must overcome the ghosts of his father and save a mission sabotaged by greedy weapons manufacturers.

Title: 19. What About Bob?
description: A successful psychotherapist loses his mind after one of his most dependent patients, an obsessive-compulsive neurotic, tracks him down during his family vacation.

Title: 20. The Last Boy Scout
description: A private detective's protected female witness is murdered, prompting him and the victim's boyfriend to investigate the crime that leads to a corrupt politician and a crooked football team owner.

Title: 21. My Girl
description: Vada is obsessed with death. Her mother is dead, and her father runs a funeral parlor. When Vada's father hires Shelly, a makeup expert, and begins to fall in love, Vada is outraged and does everything in her power to split them up.

Title: 22. Boyz n the Hood
description: Follows the lives of three young males living in the Crenshaw ghetto of Los Angeles, dissecting questions of race, relationships, violence, and future prospects.

Title: 23. Doc Hollywood
description: A young doctor on his way across the country to a job interview crashes his car in a small town and is sentenced to work for several days at the town hospital.

Title: 24. Bugsy
description: The true story of gangster Benjamin "Bugsy" Siegel, his tumultuous affair with the tough-talking Virginia Hill, and how he founded the Nevada-based city that would go on to be known as Las Vegas.

Title: 25. New Jack City
description: Two ex-policemen attempt to bring down a drug lord's ghetto empire in a drug-ravaged metropolis.

Title: 26. The Rocketeer
description: A young pilot stumbles onto a prototype jetpack that allows him to become a high-flying masked hero.

Title: 27. Thelma & Louise
description: An Arkansas waitress and a housewife shoot a rapist and take off in a '66 Thunderbird.

Title: 28. Point Break
description: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

Title: 29. Regarding Henry
description: After being shot, a lawyer loses his memory and must relearn speech and mobility, but he has a loving family to support him.

Title: 30. The Fisher King
description: A former radio DJ, suicidally despondent because of a terrible mistake he once made, finds redemption in helping a mentally unstable homeless man who was an innocent victim of that mistake.

Title: 31. Out for Justice
description: With his partner executed in broad daylight by a psychotic mafia enforcer, a veteran Brooklyn officer vows revenge. But is the unstoppable detective prepared to face the truth and pay the price of blood?

Title: 32. The Doctor
description: When a self-centered doctor is diagnosed with cancer, he becomes better able to empathize with his patients and appreciate a life outside his career.

Title: 33. Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
description: A tyrant from the future creates evil android doubles of Bill and Ted and sends them back to eliminate the originals.

Title: 34. Dead Again
description: A woman who has lost her memory is taken in by a Los Angeles orphanage, and a private eye is enlisted to track down her identity, but he soon finds that he might have a past life connection to her that endangers their lives.

Title: 35. Soapdish
description: An ambitious television soap actress connives with her producer to scuttle the career of the show's long-time star, but nothing works as they plan.

Title: 36. Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
description: Dream-haunting Freddy Krueger returns once again to prowl the nightmares of Springwood's last surviving teenager, and of a woman whose personal connection to Krueger may mean his doom.

Title: 37. White Fang
description: Jack London's classic adventure story about the friendship developed between a Yukon gold hunter and the mixed dog-wolf he rescues from the hands of a man who mistreats him.

Title: 38. The Doors
description: Jim Morrison's life, from his LA film student days to his death in Paris. Val Kilmer delivers an uncanny portrayal, with vocals indistinguishable from Morrison's originals. It depicts Morrison's journey as the iconic 60s rock frontman.

Title: 39. King Ralph
description: A regular guy from America becomes king of England after a royal wipe-out puts him next in line.

Title: 40. Curly Sue
description: A homeless man and his young companion, who survive by conning people, meet a woman who may need them even more than they need her.

Title: 41. Dying Young
description: A caregiver falls in love with a terminally ill man.

Title: 42. Grand Canyon
description: The fates of several people are randomly intertwining. Their sympathy of each other faces multiple differences in their lifestyles.

Title: 43. Jungle Fever
description: Friends and family of a married Black architect react in different ways to his affair with an Italian secretary.

Title: 44. Double Impact
description: Twin brothers are separated when their parents are murdered but 25 years later they re-unite in order to avenge their parents' death.

Title: 45. L.A. Story
description: With the help of a talking freeway billboard, a wacky weatherman tries to win the heart of an English newspaper reporter, who is struggling to make sense of the strange world of early 1990s Los Angeles.

Title: 46. Deceived
description: A man is murdered when checking authenticity of ancient Egyptian jewelry at a museum. Adrienne finds out after the death of her husband, that he was using a fake name. Are the 2 deaths linked?

Title: 47. Necessary Roughness
description: Due to NCAA sanctions, the Texas State University Fightin' Armadillos must form a football team from their actual student body, with no scholarships to help, to play their football schedule.

Title: 48. The Hard Way
description: An action movie star researching a role is allowed to tag along with a hardboiled New York City policeman, who finds him superficial and irritating.

Title: 49. Other People's Money
description: A corporate raider buys up shares in an undervalued company and falls in love with the founder's son's lawyer/step daughter. Let the battle begin.

Title: 50. Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
description: Five siblings are left alone all summer when their mom leaves town and the evil babysitter bites the dust.

Title: 51. Problem Child 2
description: The worst child in the world makes an unthinkable discovery: there is another child even worse than he is--and it's a girl.

Title: 52. Little Man Tate
description: A single mother raises a child prodigy on her own, struggling to give him every opportunity he needs to express his gift.

Title: 53. Class Action
description: An attorney representing a traumatized accident victim finds that his opponent is a very familiar defense attorney - his own daughter.

Title: 54. The People Under the Stairs
description: When Fool breaks into the home of his family's landlords, he discovers that they have mutilated several boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs. As Fool attempts to flee, he meets their daughter, Alice. Can Fool and Alice escape?

Title: 55. Oscar
description: A gangster attempts to keep the promise he made to his dying father: that he would give up his life of crime and "go straight".

Title: 56. Frankie and Johnny
description: Johnny has just been released from prison, and gets a job in a café beside waitress Frankie. Frankie is a bit of a loner, but Johnny is determined their romance will blossom.

Title: 57. Pure Luck
description: An accountant with super bad luck is sent in search of a missing boss's daughter, also an incredibly unlucky person.

Title: 58. An American Tail: Fievel Goes West
description: Fievel's family decides to move out to the West, unaware that they are falling into a trap perpetrated by a smooth-talking cat.

Title: 59. Only the Lonely
description: A Chicago cop must balance loyalty to his controlling mother and a relationship with a shy funeral home worker.

Title: 60. Ricochet
description: Years ago, a rookie cop arrested a psychotic killer. Now, the killer has escaped from prison to exact an intricate revenge plot against his captor, now an Assistant District Attorney.

Title: 61. F/X2
description: Rollie Tyler, now a maker of elaborate toys, uses his special effects skills to help a police officer catch an elusive killer.

Title: 62. Mobsters
description: From start to finish, this is a story of friendship between four street-wise mates who don't mind using violence to achieve the lives that they want. They trust no one but each other, which is vital to their success as mobsters.

Title: 63. House Party 2
description: When Kid's college money is stolen by a crooked music promoter, Play's solution is to stage the 'mutha' of all pajama parties. Starring Kid 'n Play and Martin Lawrence.

Title: 64. Mortal Thoughts
description: Two detectives interrogate a hairdresser on two homicides she may or may not have been involved in.

Title: 65. Paradise
description: A married couple (Melanie Griffith and Don Johnson) split by tragedy may find healing through their summer guest Willard Young (Elijah Wood).

Title: 66. For the Boys
description: Talented USO entertainer Dixie Leonard and comedian Eddie Sparks deal with their relationship over the course of 5 decades from World War II to the Vietnam War era to their twilight era in the 90's.

Title: 67. Hudson Hawk
description: A cat burglar is forced to steal Leonardo works of art for a world domination plot.

Title: 68. Defending Your Life
description: In an afterlife way-station resembling a major city, the lives of the recently deceased are examined in a court-like setting.

Title: 69. Billy Bathgate
description: In the year 1935, a teen named Billy Bathgate finds first love while becoming the protégé of fledgling gangster Dutch Schultz.

Title: 70. Highlander II: The Quickening
description: In the future, Highlander Connor MacLeod must prevent the destruction of Earth under an anti-ozone shield.

Title: 71. Switch
description: A sexist womanizer is killed by one of his former lovers and then reincarnated as a woman.

Title: 72. A Kiss Before Dying
description: Jonathan Corliss murders his girlfriend Dorothy and moves onto her twin sister Ellen who grows suspicious of her new lover as he charms his way into their family and impresses their father Thor Carlsson. Based on Ira Levin's novel.

Title: 73. Toy Soldiers
description: A group of troublemaking boys decide to take a stand when terrorists seize control of their boarding school.

Title: 74. Madonna: Truth or Dare
description: Documentary following singer Madonna on her controversial Blonde Ambition tour in 1990.

Title: 75. Child's Play 3
description: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.

Title: 76. The Commitments
description: Jimmy Rabbitte, an unemployed Dublin boy, decides to put together a soul band made up entirely of the Irish working class.

Title: 77. Once Around
description: A struggling woman finds unexpected love with a charismatic older salesman at a real estate seminar. Their passionate relationship clashes with the values of her family, particularly her father.

Title: 78. All I Want for Christmas
description: A brother and sister attempt to bring their divorced parents back together for Christmas.

Title: 79. Not Without My Daughter
description: An American woman trapped in Islamic Iran by her brutal husband must find a way for her and her daughter to escape.

Title: 80. Flight of the Intruder
description: During the air war over Vietnam, a U.S. Navy A-6 Intruder bomber pilot schemes with a hardened veteran to make an unauthorized air strike on Hanoi.

Title: 81. Ernest Scared Stupid
description: Ernest accidentally unleashes an ugly troll that plots to transform children into wooden dolls in the town of Briarville, Missouri.

Title: 82. The Perfect Weapon
description: An expert in "kenpo" karate avenges his Koreatown friend, slain by a mobster in Los Angeles.

Title: 83. Drop Dead Fred
description: A young woman's already-unstable life is rocked by the presence of the rambunctious imaginary friend from her childhood.

Title: 84. Enchanted April
description: Four English women, after World War I, who are unhappy with their lives, and their time away on vacation in a beautiful Italian villa.

Title: 85. The Marrying Man
description: A millionaire playboy goes to Las Vegas and comes out married to a woman he barely knows.

Title: 86. Rock-A-Doodle
description: In order to defeat the wicked Grand Duke of Owls, a young boy, transformed into a cat, teams up with a group of barnyard animals to find the rooster who can raise the sun.

Title: 87. Shattered
description: After a horrific car wreck leaves him an amnesiac, a man slowly begins to unravel his shocking past.

Title: 88. Career Opportunities
description: Jim is the dorky son of a local cement contractor who lives at home and has no direction. Josie is the gorgeous daughter of a wealthy businessman who dreams of leaving town. They find they have a lot in common.

Title: 89. One Good Cop
description: A New York Police Detective and his Wife try to take care of his slain partner's three daughters.

Title: 90. V.I. Warshawski
description: A female PI babysitting for a boyfriend gets stuck with his daughter and the case of her murdered father.

Title: 91. The Super
description: Karma comes into play when a wealthy wisecracking landlord is ordered by a court to live in the filthy building that he runs.

Title: 92. A Rage in Harlem
description: A gangster's girlfriend flees to Harlem with a trunkload of gold after a shootout, unaware that the rest of the gang are on her trail.

Title: 93. Operation Condor
description: Jackie is hired to help the UN find Nazi gold hidden in Sahara. He's accompanied from Spain by 2 (later 3) cute women. As there are others wanting the gold, lots of kung fu fighting and comedy follows.

Title: 94. He Said, She Said
description: The tumultuous relationship between the co-hosts of a morning news segment is explored from the point of view of both the man and the woman.

Title: 95. The Butcher's Wife
description: A clairvoyant impulsively marries a butcher, moves to New York City, and has a positive impact on the people she meets, changing their futures...which in turn changes hers.

Title: 96. Scenes from a Mall
description: On their 16th anniversary, a married couple's trip to a Beverly Hills mall becomes the stage for personal revelations and deceptions.

Title: 97. Guilty by Suspicion
description: Returning to Hollywood 1951 after working in France, a movie director meets McCarthyism head-on.

Title: 98. Body Parts
description: After losing his arm in a car accident, a criminal psychologist has it replaced with a limb that belonged to a serial killer.

Title: 99. Stone Cold
description: A tough Alabama cop is blackmailed by the FBI into going undercover in a violent Mississippi biker gang.

Title: 100. Late for Dinner
description: Two young men evading the police for a crime they didn't commit are cryogenically frozen in the early 1960s. The next thing they know is that they are in a strange new world (thirty years on).

Title: 101. The Five Heartbeats
description: The story of the rise and fall of an African American vocal group.

Title: 102. Bingo
description: A runaway circus dog befriends a young boy who has trouble fitting in with his friends.

Title: 103. Nothing But Trouble
description: A businessman and his friends are captured by a sadistic judge and his equally odd family in a bizarre mansion in the backwoods.

Title: 104. Black Robe
description: In the 17th century, a Jesuit missionary nicknamed Black Robe by the natives and his small party of companions try reaching the Huron tribe in Canada all while facing mistrust, Iroquois warring parties and harsh winter conditions.

Title: 105. If Looks Could Kill
description: Michael has to take summer class in French, a class trip to France, to graduate high school. He is, however, mistaken for an agent and people try to kill him. There are 007 style cars, cuties, crooks etc.

Title: 106. Strictly Business
description: Sharp social satire in which the uneven friendship between an ambitious Black businessman and his streetwise pal is thrown into further confusion when the professional falls in love with a mind-numbingly gorgeous waitress.

Title: 107. Harley Davidson and the Marlboro Man
description: Two lone riders hold up a bank's armoured car to save their friend's bar from imminent foreclosure. Soon, the mission goes awry when they discover the vehicle's unexpected cargo.

Title: 108. Mississippi Masala
description: An ethnic Indian family is expelled from Idi Amin's Uganda in 1972 and lives in Mississippi 17 years later. The dad sues Uganda to get his property back. The grown daughter falls in love with a Black man.

Title: 109. Wild Hearts Can't Be Broken
description: Thrilled by a performance she sees at a fair, Sonora Webster tries to land a spot as a daredevil who rides horses off of high dives.

Title: 110. Rush
description: Two small-town Texas cops go undercover to catch a major drug dealer and are sucked into the drug culture, compromising their assignment.

Title: 111. Suburban Commando
description: An interstellar hero from a distant world visits Earth, and tries to fit in with a mundane, yet kind, suburban family.

Title: 112. Defenseless
description: A lawyer is hired to defend an old college friend accused of murdering her husband.

Title: 113. My Own Private Idaho
description: Two best friends living on the streets of Portland as hustlers embark on a journey of self discovery and find their relationship stumbling along the way.

Title: 114. Rambling Rose
description: A young woman who exudes sexuality battles temptation.

Title: 115. Mystery Date
description: Tom's in love with the cute house sitter next door. He's too shy but his older brother visits and helps Tom with the first date. Things don't go as planned.

Title: 116. Barton Fink
description: A renowned New York playwright is enticed to California to write for the movies and discovers the hellish truth of Hollywood.

Title: 117. Delirious
description: A soap opera writer gets hit on the head and wakes up as a character in his own show.

Title: 118. Livin' Large!
description: A young Black reporter begins to lose his identity.

Title: 119. Eve of Destruction
description: A terrorist hunter is hired by a scientist to deactivate her android double, a walking, talking, murderous nuclear bomb which has gone amok in the big city and is about to explode.

Title: 120. The Object of Beauty
description: This story is about a ne'er-do-well and his girlfriend as they search for a thief.

Title: 121. True Identity
description: In order to escape from the mob, an African-American man must disguise himself as a white man.

Title: 122. The Hitman
description: A Cop goes undercover as a Hitman to bring down a criminal organization.

Title: 123. Dutch
description: To get to know his girlfriend's son, a working-class good guy volunteers to pick him up from his prep school, only to learn that he isn't the nicest young man.

Title: 124. Mediterraneo
description: In WW2, an Italian Army unit of misfits occupies an isolated non-strategic Greek island for the duration of the war.

Title: 125. Run
description: When a law student accidentally kills the son of a mob boss in a fight, he finds himself relentlessly pursued by the mob and the police.

Title: 126. Hear My Song
description: The owner of a failing club seeks infamous Irish singer Josef Locke in order to bring business and success to his club.

Title: 127. Popcorn
description: A master of disguise deranged killer begins killing off the college students who are organizing a horror-movie marathon in an abandoned theater.

Title: 128. Life Stinks
description: A filthy-rich businessman bets a corporate rival that he can live on the streets of L.A. without the comforts of home or money, but it proves to be tougher than he thought.

Title: 129. Impromptu
description: In 1830s France, pianist/composer Frédéric Chopin is pursued romantically by the determined, individualistic woman who uses the name George Sand.

Title: 130. Mannequin: On the Move
description: A young department store intern falls in love with a female store mannequin who is really a peasant girl fallen under a thousand year spell. She comes to life whenever he removes the cursed necklace from her.

Title: 131. My Heroes Have Always Been Cowboys
description: A rodeo rider decides to quit his line of work after a serious injury, but when he visits his family and finds out that his dad is not well, he'll have to risk it one more time.

Title: 132. Shout
description: A new music teacher in a 1955 West Texas home for wayward boys brings new vision and hope for many of the interned boys.

Title: 133. K2
description: A U.S. climbing team, funded by millionaire Clairborne is determined to conquer K2.

Title: 134. All the Mornings of the World
description: The story of Monsieur de Sainte Colombe, fierce and somber man, grand master of the viola da gamba and professor of Marin Marais, prestigious musician in the court of Louis XIV.

Title: 135. Homicide
description: A Jewish homicide detective investigates a seemingly minor murder and falls in with a radical Jewish group as a result.

Title: 136. Another You
description: A con-man takes advantage of the situation of a psychiatric out-patient being mistaken for a missing millionaire.

Title: 137. The Man in the Moon
description: A coming of age story set in the south of the U.S. when Elvis was King.

Title: 138. Return to the Blue Lagoon
description: During the Victorian period, two adoptive siblings are marooned on a tropical island in the South Pacific and enjoy a simple life together before they become suntanned teenagers in love.

Title: 139. Shadows and Fog
description: With a serial strangler on the loose, a bookkeeper wanders around town searching for the vigilante group intent on catching the killer.

Title: 140. Straight Out of Brooklyn
description: A young man living in poverty makes a plan to rob a drug dealer and change the life of his family.

Title: 141. Naked Lunch
description: After developing an addiction to the substance he uses to kill bugs, an exterminator accidentally kills his wife and becomes involved in a secret government plot being orchestrated by giant bugs in a port town in North Africa.

Title: 142. Raise the Red Lantern
description: A young woman becomes the fourth concubine of a wealthy man and soon realizes there's fierce competition for his attention and the associated privileges.

Title: 143. Flirting
description: Two freethinking teenagers - a boy and a girl - confront with authoritarian teachers in their boarding schools. The other students treat this differently.

Title: 144. A Brief History of Time
description: A film about the life and work of the cosmologist, Stephen Hawking, who despite his near total paralysis, was one of the great minds of all time.

Title: 145. Showdown in Little Tokyo
description: Two L.A. cops with opposing views on what is the best way to uphold the law have to work together to bring down the Yakuza, while trying to protect a beautiful woman.

Title: 146. 29th Street
description: Frank's been lucky from the day he was born. So why's he throwing rocks at a church after winning $6,200,000 in 1976 NYC lottery? He tells his story at the police station.

Title: 147. The Nutcracker
description: On Christmas Eve, a little girl named Marie falls asleep after a party at her house and dreams of a fantastic world where toys become larger than life.

Title: 148. The Princess and the Goblin
description: A naive princess, her beloved cat and a poor mining boy team up to save their kingdom from a nasty underground realm of bad-mannered goblins.

Title: 149. Married to It
description: 3 unlike couples get to know each other thru a committee at a private NYC school.

Title: 150. Night on Earth
description: An anthology of 5 different cab drivers in 5 American and European cities and their remarkable fares on the same eventful night.

Title: 151. The Double Life of Véronique
description: Two parallel stories about two identical women; one living in Poland, the other in France. They don't know each other, but their lives are nevertheless profoundly connected.

Title: 152. Madame Bovary
description: In nineteenth-century France, the romantic daughter of a country squire marries a dull country doctor. To escape boredom, she throws herself into love affairs with a suave local landowner and a law student, and runs up ruinous debts.

Title: 153. Delicatessen
description: Post-apocalyptic surrealist black comedy about the landlord of an apartment building who occasionally prepares a delicacy for his odd tenants.

Title: 154. Prospero's Books
description: The magician Prospero attempts to stop his daughter's affair with an enemy.

Title: 155. High Heels
description: A singer returns after 15 years abroad to perform in Madrid and finds her 27 y.o. daughter married to one of her mom's ex-lovers.

Title: 156. Daughters of the Dust
description: A languid, impressionistic story of three generations of Gullah women living on the South Carolina Sea Islands in 1902.

Title: 157. One False Move
description: A small town police chief awaits the arrival of a gang of killers.

Title: 158. Company Business
description: A retired CIA agent is recruited to participate in a prisoner exchange with the Russians.

Title: 159. Lovers: A True Story
description: 1950s Madrid: After military service, Paco looks for work to save up and marry his fiancée. She rejects his sexual advances. So when he rents a room with a cute widow making advances, he caves in.

Title: 160. Where Angels Fear to Tread
description: After a rich Edwardian widow impulsively marries a handsome but poor Tuscan dentist and dies in childbirth, her English in-laws try to gain custody of the baby.

Title: 161. At Play in the Fields of the Lord
description: In the South American jungle, fundamentalist missionaries Martin and Hazel clash with tribe members and rival groups while pilot Lewis gets entangled with mission head Leslie's wife Andy amid encroaching civilization.

Title: 162. City of Hope
description: An intersecting tale with a multitude of characters living lives which, in one way or another, revolve around an old apartment block scheduled to be demolished.

Title: 163. Hearts of Darkness: A Filmmaker's Apocalypse
description: Documentary that chronicles how Francis Ford Coppola's Apocalypse Now (1979) was plagued by extraordinary script, shooting, budget, and casting problems - nearly destroying the life and career of the celebrated director.

Title: 164. The Rapture
description: A telephone operator living an empty, amoral life finds God and loses him again.

Title: 165. Kickboxer 2: The Road Back
description: David's brother, Kurt, defeats Po in Kickboxer (1989). A year after Po kills Kurt, David, who has a kickboxing gym in LA, is manipulated into a match against Po.

Title: 166. Toto the Hero
description: Thomas believed he was switched at birth with Alfred. Feeling cheated, Thomas spent his life plotting revenge against Alfred, his perceived lifelong adversary who he felt stole the privileged life that should have been his.

Title: 167. Cool as Ice
description: A rapper gets stuck in a small town and falls for a local girl whose family is in witness protection.

Title: 168. Year of the Gun
description: In 1978, a journalist and a photojournalist, both young Americans, had a close encounter with Red Brigades terrorists in Rome.

Title: 169. The Unborn
description: A couple struggling to conceive visit a miracle doctor as a last hope for having a child. The wife gets pregnant, but after the initial joy comes horror, as she slowly discovers the nightmarish truth behind the doctor's success.

Title: 170. Kafka
description: Kafka works during the day at an insurance company, where events lead him to discover a mysterious underground society with strange suppressive goals.

Title: 171. Whore
description: A night in the life of a cynical prostitute forms the basis of Ken Russell's portrait of the world's oldest profession.

Title: 172. Europa
description: Just after World War II, an American takes a railway job in Germany, but finds his position politically sensitive with various people trying to use him.

Title: 173. Meeting Venus
description: Hungarian conductor plans bold "Tannhäuser" production amid opera politics, artistic egos, nationalism, union conflicts, and funding challenges in critique of Grand Opera and European Union.

Title: 174. Talkin' Dirty After Dark
description: The laughs and overlapping love lives of a handful of raunchy stand-up comics at a late-night L.A. comedy club. Dukie's is an L.A. hot-spot featuring a lineup of both novice and notorious comedians who get big laughs with dirty jokes.

Title: 175. The Taking of Beverly Hills
description: A group of embittered ex-cops use a chemical spill to raid the banks and homes of Beverly Hills.

Title: 176. Beastmaster 2: Through the Portal of Time
description: Dar is a warrior who can talk to the beasts. He is forced to travel to Earth to stop his evil brother from stealing an atomic bomb and turning their native land from a desert into, well - a desert.

Title: 177. The Miracle
description: The two teenagers Jimmy and Rose spend their vacation at the small Irish sea-resort Bray. Out of boredom they observe other people and imagine wild stories about them. One day they observe the blonde Renee, and Jimmy is immediately fascinated by her and even follows her home. She, too, seems to like him, but for a mysterious reason keeps him at a distance.

Title: 178. Until the End of the World
description: Claire and Eugene's relationship is falling apart, while a nuclear satellite threatens to fall out of orbit and destroy Earth. Claire travels the world when she meets Sam, a man with connections to technology that could change everything.

Title: 179. Cabeza de Vaca
description: A handful of survivors from a disastrous 1528 Spanish expedition to Florida journey across the coast until they reach Mexico.

Title: 180. Poison
description: A boy shoots his father and flies out the window. A man falls in love with a fellow inmate in prison. A doctor accidentally ingests his experimental sex serum, wreaking havoc on the community.

Title: 181. Edward II
description: In this Derek Jarman version of Christopher Marlowe's Elizabethan drama, in modern costumes and settings, Plantagenet king Edward II hands the power-craving nobility the perfect excuse by taking as lover besides his diplomatic wife, the French princess Isabel, not an acceptable lady at court but the ambitious Piers Gaveston, who uses his favor in bed even to wield political influence - the stage is set for a palace revolt which sends the gay pair from the throne to a terminal torture dungeon.

Title: 182. Into the Sun
description: A fighter pilot is reluctantly paired with a Hollywood actor who's researching a role, but are then forced to team up for real after being shot down and thrust into combat.

Title: 183. Dice Rules
description: Outrageous, misogynistic and vulgar-to-the-max comedian Andrew Dice Clay does his stuff in this combination of a stand-up concert video, in a filled-to-capacity performance at Madison Square Gardens, and a series of comedy sketches.

Title: 184. Johnny Stecchino
description: A kindhearted but bumbling idiot who likes to steal bananas, is passed off for a snitch hiding from the mob.

Title: 185. Queens Logic
description: A group of lifelong friends meet again in Queens for Ray's (Ken Olin) bachelor party and wedding.

Title: 186. The Pope Must Diet
description: A less-than-qualified and far-from-perfect priest is mistakenly named the new Pope. As the Pontiff, he must deal with Vatican corruption, the Mob, and the reappearance of a former lover.

Title: 187. The Search for Signs of Intelligent Life in the Universe
description: This filmed version of Lily Tomlin's successful one-woman performance piece is sometimes classified as a "documentary."

Title: 188. Wild Orchid II: Two Shades of Blue
description: In 1958 California, a teenage girl goes to work as a prostitute in a high-class brothel after the death of her father.

Title: 189. Rich Girl
description: A rich Beverly Hills girl gets a job as a waitress, and falls in love with a rock singer.

Title: 190. Hangin' with the Homeboys
description: Four young friends spend one crazy Friday night on the streets of Manhattan that quickly turns into a night, they'll never forget.

Title: 191. Sex, Drugs, Rock & Roll
description: Performance artist/comedian Bogosian brings to hilarious life 10 separate oddball characters in a one-man-show. This profane, smart, crisply edited film will have you screaming for more.

Title: 192. Proof
description: The life of a blind photographer who is looked after by a housekeeper is disrupted by the arrival of an agreeable restaurant worker.

Title: 193. Voyager
description: April 1957: Rational engineer Faber's plane crashes in Mexico. He learns that he became a dad in 1938. He takes a ship from NYC to France and meets cute, young Sabeth. Fate?

Title: 194. Rhapsody in August
description: Three generations' responses to the atomic bombing of Nagasaki.

Title: 195. McBain
description: A former Vietnam War lieutenant reforms his old team in order to help a revolutionary's sister overthrow a ruthless dictator.

Title: 196. Only Yesterday
description: A twenty-seven-year-old office worker travels to the countryside while reminiscing about her childhood in Tokyo.

Title: 197. Danzón
description: Julia (Rojo) is a phone operator in Mexico City who divides her time between her job, her daughter and the Danzon: a Cuban dance very popular in Mexico and Central America. Every Wednesday Julia does the Danzon with Carmelo (Rergis) in the old "Salon Colonia". They've danced for years but barely know each other. One night Carmelo disappears without a trace. Feeling lonely and sad, Julia takes a train to Veracruz, where she knows Carmelo has a brother. That sudden trip will change Julia's life forever.

Title: 198. Especially on Sunday
description: 1) A lovesick girl has a soothing effect on another couple. 2) A mother lets her daughter-in-law watch while she is making love. 3) A dog-hater is baffled by a dog that befriends him. 4) A beach party crowd watch wooden churches float by.

Title: 199. True Colors
description: Best friends from law school to election night, their friendship is sorely tested when one learns of another's betrayal.

Title: 200. La belle noiseuse
description: The former famous painter Frenhofer revisits an abandoned project using the girlfriend of a young visiting artist. Questions about truth, life, and artistic limits are explored.

Title: 201. The Adjuster
description: A family with the lack of sincerity faces a crisis.

Title: 202. Dogfight
description: Before leaving to fight in Vietnam, a group of teenagers play a game where they try to seduce the ugliest girl they can find.

Title: 203. Sweet Talker
description: A sweet-talking con man starts to turn his life around when he falls in love in this family oriented comedy.

Title: 204. Close to Eden
description: A curious friendship develops between Gombo, a young Mongolian shepherd living with his wife and family in a hut, deep in the wilderness of the steppes, and Sergei, a Russian worker whose truck breaks down not far from Gombo's hut.

Title: 205. Talent for the Game
description: Virgil Sweet is on the verge of losing his job as a talent scout with the California Angels when he discovers Sammy Bodeen, a country boy with no pro ball experience, but with a pitching arm no one has seen the like of.

Title: 206. Hard Promises
description: With only seventy-two hours to keep his future from being a bleak one, Joey pulls out all the stops to win back his ex-wife before she remarries.

Title: 207. Riff-Raff
description: The story of construction-worker Stevie and his unemployed pop-singer girlfriend shows the living conditions of the British poor class.

Title: 208. Becoming Colette
description: The story of a girl who become the toast of Paris high-society. Through her marriage to one of France's most notorious degenerates, Colette's eyes are opened to every form of sexual depravity - shameless adventures that stir her.

Title: 209. Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
description: A girl fed up with her quirky, dysfunctional family runs away from home, causing all of them to spend time with each other.

Title: 210. Twenty-One
description: Katie is a free spirited independently minded 21-year-old girl. The film follows her as she reflects on the men in her life. Along the way we meet her drug addict boyfriend Bobby, her lover Jack, close friend Baldy, and her father.

Title: 211. Stepping Out
description: A has-been Broadway performer gives tap lessons to a group of misfits who, through their dance classes, bond and realize what they can achieve.

Title: 212. Young Soul Rebels
description: Two disc jockeys have a friend's murder to solve in the fringe-group melting pot of 1977 London.

Title: 213. Under Suspicion
description: Disgraced detective Tony fakes evidence in divorce cases, implicates wife in Stasio affair. Stasio and wife shot dead in hotel. Tony's ex-partner Frank investigates, suspects inheritance-seeking mistress Angeline and inconsistent Tony.

Title: 214. Van Gogh
description: The final sixty-seven days of Van Gogh's life are examined.

Title: 215. The Indian Runner
description: Late-1960s tragedy of a policeman and his Vietnam veteran brother.

Title: 216. The Ballad of the Sad Cafe
description: A tangled triangle. In the rural South of the early 20th century, Miss Amelia is the town eccentric, selling corn liquor and dispensing medicine. She takes in her half-sister's son, a diminutive crook-back named Lymon. He suggests they open a café in the downstairs of her large house. Marvin Macy gets out of prison and returns to town; turns out he was married to Amelia but it wasn't consummated. He pleaded, then got angry. Is he back for revenge? Eventually, Amelia and Marvin stage a no-holds-barred fight in the café. Lymon's complicated response to Marvin and to Cousin Amelia figures in the resolution.

Title: 217. The Efficiency Expert
description: An expert on productivity shows wacky workers in 1966 Australia how to run their moccasin factory like clockwork, despite laying off more than half the workforce.

Title: 218. London Kills Me
description: A young Londoner seeks to escape the drug scene by landing a waiter job, but his lack of proper footwear becomes a hurdle. The quest for shoes symbolizes his struggle to break free from a world of addiction and vice.

Title: 219. Pushing Hands
description: All the while, Master Chu tries to find his place in the foreign American world.

Title: 220. Close My Eyes
description: An estranged brother and sister begin an intense sexual relationship, behind the curtain of their otherwise normal working-class lives.

Title: 221. Liebestraum
description: Returning to a small Illinois town to visit his dying mother, architecture professor Nick Kaminski meets an old friend - a construction company manager about to demolish an old department store, and begins an affair with his wife.

Title: 222. Shakes the Clown
description: Shakes is good at his job as party clown - when he's sober and shows up. Five druggy clowns frame him for the murder of his boss.

Title: 223. Cold Heaven
description: An adulterous woman's faith in God is tested when her husband dies and miraculously comes back to life.

Title: 224. The Inner Circle
description: The true story of Ivan Sanchin, the KGB officer who was Stalin's private film projectionist from 1939 until the dictator's death. Told from Sanchin's view, the sympathetic but tragically flawed hero maintains unwavering faith in his "Master" despite the arrest of his neighbors and his involvement with their daughter, his wife's affair with the chilling State Security chief Lavrentii Beria and her tragic decline, and the deadly political machinations within the Kremlin he witnesses firsthand.

Title: 225. Johnny Suede
description: A struggling young musician and devoted fan of Ricky Nelson wants to be just like his idol and become a rock star.

Title: 226. Let Him Have It
description: This drama reveals the controversial postwar 1950's London murder trial that sent an intellectually challenged young man to the gallows for a murder he did not commit.

Title: 227. To Want to Fly
description: Martina is a professional lady whose clients are harmless if eccentric; she sees herself as a social worker. Shy Maurizio dubs sound for cartoons while his outgoing brother dubs more saucy material and gets the girls. After Maurizio accidentally helps Martina on some of her assignations she decides to find out if he wants to help regularly. Whether or not it's the possibility of romance, Maurizio is horrified to find on their first date that his hands have been replaced by cartoon ones with minds of their own.

Title: 228. The Lovers on the Bridge
description: Alex, who's homeless and addicted to alcohol, and Michèle, who's losing her sight, form a relationship while sleeping rough on Paris's Pont-Neuf bridge.

Title: 229. Afraid of the Dark
description: A little boy, obsessed with blindness and violence, slowly gets trapped in his own delusions.

Title: 230. Bed & Breakfast
description: Three generations of women (Talia Shire, Nina Siemaszko, and Colleen Dewhurst) run a failing bed and breakfast in this gentle romantic comedy. Everything changes when a charming mysterious stranger (Sir Roger Moore) shows up on the scene.

Title: 231. Salmonberries
description: A woman who grew up in a small town in Alaska goes to the public library to try and find out who her parents were. She was brought to town as a baby in a cardboard box with "Kotzebue" on it, which is the name of the town and also the name of the family that founded the town. She eventually befriends the librarian, an East German immigrant who lost her husband while escaping from behind the Iron Curtain. They help each other try to find closure to the events in their past.

Title: 232. Bloodfist III: Forced to Fight
description: Jimmy Boland is a man unjustly accused of a brutal crime. Within the prison he must fight for survival, freedom and justice.

Title: 233. Diary of a Hitman
description: A veteran hit man, Dekker is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck recruits the assassin to kill his wife.

Title: 234. Crooked Hearts
description: How the discovery of a father's affair affects each member of his family.

Title: 235. The Dark Backward
description: Garbage man Marty tries his hand at standup comedy and fails miserably until he adds the third arm to his act that mysteriously grew out of his back.

Title: 236. Lyrisch nitraat
description: A compilation of scenes from silent films made between 1905 and 1915 that sat in storage in an Amsterdam cinema for many years. The title refers to the deteriorating nitrate film stock used in these films.

Title: 237. Highway to Hell
description: An eloping bride is taken into Hell, and her fiancé must pursue.

Title: 238. American Friends
description: Reverend Francis Ashby (Sir Michael Palin), a senior Oxford don on vacation alone in the Alps, meets vacationing American Miss Caroline Hartley (Connie Booth) and her companion Miss Elinor Hartley (Trini Alvarado), the blossoming Irish-American girl she adopted many years before. Ashby finds he enjoys their company, particularly that of Elinor, and both of the women are drawn to him. Back at Oxford he is nevertheless taken aback when they arrive unannounced. Women are not allowed in the College grounds, let alone the rooms. Indeed any liaison, however innocent, is frowned on by the upstanding Fellows.

Title: 239. Ski School
description: Rival groups in a skiing school do battle on and off the piste. One gang are rich and serious, the other group are party animals.

Title: 240. Center Stage
description: Biopic of 1930s Chinese actress Lingyu Ruan.

Title: 241. A Fine Romance
description: An Italian gentleman and a doctor's wife plot to break up their spouses' tryst in Paris.

Title: 242. Jumpin' at the Boneyard
description: Manny tries to get his crack addict brother, Danny, to clean up.

Title: 243. Rubin and Ed
description: An unsuccessful, nervous businessman gradually comes to befriend an eccentric, asocial nerd on a trip to Utah to bury a deceased cat.

Title: 244. Drive
description: The Driver (David Warner) monologues and ruminates on life while taking his passenger to their different destinations.

Title: 245. The Ox
description: Swedish pauper's family is starving. In desperation, he steals his lord's ox. He hopes that the crime will not be revealed, but it happens.

Title: 246. Convicts
description: Horton Foote's story of a teen-aged boy in the Depression who finds work on an eccentric's sugar plantation and learns life's surprising lessons from the team of convicts who also work there.

Title: 247. I Can No Longer Hear the Guitar
description: For those who were young, living under the delusions of love and soft drugs in Paris, May 1968 - even if the guitar is still playing, they can't hear it any longer.

Title: 248. Motorama
description: A ten year-old boy runs away from his abusive parents, steals a Mustang, and pursues a promotional card game sold at gas stations.

Title: 249. Love in the Time of Hysteria
description: A womanizer is falsely diagnosed with AIDS by a jealous lover and falls in love with a woman equally suicidal as he.

Title: 250. Blood and Concrete
description: A car thief and a punk rocker fall in love as they become embroiled in deaths attributed to an aphrodisiac.

Title: 251. Night and Day
description: Jack and Julie live in a bare flat in Paris. At night, Jack drives a taxi while Julie wanders around the city, and in the day they make love. One day Julie meets Joseph, the daytime driver of the taxi, and soon Julie is spending her nights with Joseph and her days with Jack.

Title: 252. By the Sword
description: An elderly man named Max comes to the famous fencing coach Villard and asks to be taken on as a coach. But Villard does not like his weapon technique, and he only takes Max as a cleaner.

Title: 253. December
description: Set in a New England prep school on the day after Pearl Harbor, five close friends must choose whether to stay in school or go to war. Their decisions shock themselves and each other as they must grow up faster than they ever imagined.

Title: 254. Scissors
description: A woman trying to recover from a sexual attack is locked in a posh apartment with a corpse of the very man she's been dreaming would murder her. She tries to hang on to reality when objects around her seem to come to life.

Title: 255. The Hours and Times
description: A fictionalized account of what may have happened when John Lennon and Brian Epstein went on holiday together to Spain in 1963.

Title: 256. Paprika
description: A young country girl comes to town and works in a brothel in order to help her fiance get the money to start his own business. "Paprika" is the name given to her by the madam.

Title: 257. A Brighter Summer Day
description: Based on a true story, primarily on a conflict between two youth gangs, a 14-year-old boy's girlfriend conflicts with the head of one gang for an unclear reason, until finally the conflict comes to a violent climax.

Title: 258. Sex and Zen
description: A young, good looking Chinese scholar marries a virgin girl from a conservative upbringing, but dreams of going out and experiencing as many sexual adventures as possible, but with one problem, he has a small penis.

Title: 259. Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
description: Time travelers use Godzilla in their scheme to destroy Japan to prevent the country's future economic reign.

Title: 260. The Resurrected
description: Charles Dexter Ward's wife enlists the help of a private detective to find out what her husband is up to in a remote cabin owned by his family for centuries.

Title: 261. Doraemon: Nobita's Dorabian Nights
description: Nobita and his friends go to rescue Shizuka into the world of the "Arabian Nights (Thousand and One Nights)".

Title: 262. Guyver
description: Young man merges with mechanical device, becoming cyborg superhero. Strange creatures emerge, seeking to reclaim device. He uncovers plot to genetically engineer monstrous creatures.

Title: 263. 964 Pinocchio
description: Pinocchio 964, a lobotomised cyborg sex slave, is abandoned by his owners due to his inability to maintain an erection, while the corporate entity plans to kill him.

Title: 264. Critters 3
description: The tiny fur ball aliens that will eat anything or anyone set their sights on a Los Angeles apartment tower.

Title: 265. The Raffle
description: An incredibly beautiful young woman loses her husband and in order to pay off his debts, she decided to set-up a raffle in which she is the prize.

Title: 266. Wedlock
description: A male prison escapee heads for his hidden loot electronically attached to a female prisoner.

Title: 267. The Cat
description: An adaptation of the novel Old Cat, by Ni Kuang. A cat from outer space teams up with a young alien girl and her knight, along with an adventure novelist named Wisely, to fight a murderous alien that possesses people.

Title: 268. HauntedWeen
description: Twenty years after a fatal incident, Eddie Burber's old home, now haunted, hosts a fraternity fundraiser. Unbeknownst to them, real deaths occur amid the haunted house thrills as they're hunted and trapped inside.

Title: 269. Robin Hood
description: The Swashbuckling legend of Robin Hood unfolds in the 12th century when the mighty Normans ruled England with an iron fist.

Title: 270. Sandesham
description: A satire on contemporary Kerala politics where brothers turn local leaders of rival parties, leading to distress for their aged and once-proud parents.

Title: 271. Fight Back to School
description: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

Title: 272. Dead Space
description: A deadly virus attacks the crew of a Saturn space station.

Title: 273. The Pit and the Pendulum
description: Horror film set in 1492 Toledo, Spain, depicting the cruel deeds of a monk named Torquemada, Grand Inquisitor of the Spanish Inquisition.

Title: 274. The Sect
description: A lonely kindergarten teacher discovers a secret well in the basement of her house, and soon finds herself being followed by a murderous Satanic cult.

Title: 275. The Hideaway
description: A 12-year-old kid who misses his father becomes really affectionate with a young delinquent he just met.

Title: 276. Dragon Ball Z: Cooler's Revenge
description: Frieza's older brother Cooler travels to Earth to take revenge against Goku for Frieza's defeat on planet Namek.

Title: 277. The Boneyard
description: Children turned into zombies wreak havoc in a coroner's building with just a burned-out psychic, an experienced cop and two coroners to stop the madness.

Title: 278. Aditya 369
description: Children investigating a robbery discover a time machine. A couple trying to rescue them gets trapped, leading to adventures in 16th century India under Krishnadevaraya's reign and a distant future world.

Title: 279. Dragon Ball Z: Lord Slug
description: A Super Namekian named Lord Slug comes to invade Earth and only Goku can stop him .

Title: 280. American Shaolin
description: An American martial arts film directed by Lucas Lowe. The story follows a young American martial artist named Jason Stillwell, who travels to China after a humiliating defeat in a kickboxing match. His goal is to learn Shaolin Kung Fu to improve his skills and restore his honor. Upon arriving in China, Jason faces cultural differences and the strict discipline of the Shaolin monastery. He struggles to earn the respect of the monks and prove his dedication. Throughout his training, Jason learns fighting techniques and important philosophical lessons about humility and inner strength. The film explores Jason's journey of personal growth and his efforts to master Shaolin Kung Fu while navigating various challenges and rivalries within the monastery.

Title: 281. Roujin Z
description: A compassionate young nurse is determined to help an elderly invalid strapped to a revolutionary health care bed but there are unexpected consequences.

Title: 282. Scanners II: The New Order
description: A scanner discovers a plot by renegade elements in the city government to take power with the help of evil scanners.

Title: 283. Attention, Papa Arrives!
description: After ordering enough typewriting paper for 40 years, just to get discount, Heinrich Lohse is forced to retire. The former manager has plenty of time now to spend with his wife and their 16 year old son. But - do they want that?

Title: 284. Zeiram
description: Bounty hunters Iria and Bob travel to Earth to capture an escaped bio-engineered fighting machine called Zeiramu.

Title: 285. Prahaar: The Final Attack
description: Prahaar is the story of Major Chauhan, a tough and stern soldier, trained to destroy the enemy. He can see the enemy on our borders but is unaware of the invisible enemy within ourselves. When one of Major's Commandos - Peter D'Souza is killed, he is shown the harsh reality revolving around us, the enemy is within ourselves. The battlefield changes and Major Chavan makes his final attack on the enemy within this crumbling society.

Title: 286. Urotsukidôji II: Legend of the Demon Womb
description: In this sequel to Urotsukidoji: Legend of the Overfiend, the unbelievable sexual violence of the Overfiend and his cohorts from Hell continues to wreak havoc on the earth. Who can stop this relentless onslaught?

Title: 287. Germany Year 90 Nine Zero
description: Characterized by deconstructivism and philosophical references and by briefly exposing the good, bad, and ugly periods of the country's history, this post-modern film portrays the abstract need for guidance of Germany following the fall of the Berlin Wall.

Title: 288. Njan Gandharvan
description: The film is an esoteric fantasy about a girl and her passion for a celestial lover, who keeps appearing from a wooden statue that she found on a beach but is invisible to others.

Title: 289. A Man and Two Women
description: Martha, a writer who has trouble with her romantic relationships puts herself into her characters, among these, she plays a mother who abandons her husband, a incestuous sister and cold and secretive intellectual.

Title: 290. Mookkillarajyathu
description: Four Mental patients escape from a mental hospital and go on an adventure.

Title: 291. Charuga
description: Based on the true story about Jovo Stanivukovic, alias Caruga, a bandit who became a legend in post-WW1 Slavonia.

Title: 292. War in the Land of Egypt
description: When a village mayor's son is called up for military service, his family arranges for a poor farmer's son to enlist under the boy's name in exchange for land, setting in motion a story of sacrifice, privilege, and injustice.

Title: 293. Controlled Conversations
description: Stanislaw Tym revives his career-making role as government agent Ryszard Ochodzki in this follow-up to The Bear that tracks Ryszard on a brand-new assignment. Col. Molibden has asked him to infiltrate the legendary labor movement known as Solidarity.

Title: 294. Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky
description: Riki-Oh, a young man who has superhuman strength, is incarcerated in a private prison, where inmates are treated like slaves. He is forced to use his unstoppable form of martial arts to destroy the corrupt officials and their lackeys.

Title: 295. Thalapathi
description: An orphan named Surya raised in a slum befriends a good crime boss named Devaraj and works for him. Their existence is threatened when a new honest district collector arrives.

Title: 296. Once Upon a Time in China
description: Legendary martial arts hero Wong Fei-Hung fights against foreign forces' plundering of China. When Aunt Yee arrives back from America, Wong Fei-Hung assumes the role of her protector.

Title: 297. The Grand Tour
description: A widower and his daughter's inn renovation is interrupted by mysterious travelers needing lodging. Their refusal to stay in town leads to revelations affecting the family and community.

Title: 298. Robotrix
description: A man transfers his mind to an android, and kidnaps a middle eastern prince, demanding a ransom. Meanwhile, he goes on a spree of raping and killing prostitutes. The police secret androids, Robotrix, are the only ones that could stop him.

Title: 299. Chuck Amuck: The Movie
description: Discussion of the career of animator Chuck Jones.

Title: 300. Pecado original
description: A couple of models are murder! Now it's up to a couple of bumbling cops to solve the case.

Title: 301. Nudist Colony of the Dead
description: Zombie nudists attack campers five years after the closure of the Sunny Buttocks nudist colony in various musical numbers.

Title: 302. Zandalee
description: Thierry's wife Zandalee married the poet he once was. Taking over his dad's company in New Orleans gives him stress and impotence. Thierry meets his high school buddy Johnny at a bachelor party. The painter Johnny can satisfy Zandalee.

Title: 303. Malizia 2000
description: The teenage son of an architect falls for an older woman, an attractive housewife of his father's client.

Title: 304. Nekromantik 2
description: A female nurse desperately tries to hide her feelings of necrophilia from her new boyfriend, but still has pieces of the corpse of the first movie's hero in her possession.

Title: 305. Future Kick
description: On Earth in the future, Don "The Dragon" Wilson takes on a sinister corporation that trades in black market human body parts. He single handedly manages to restore law and order in a motion picture tour de force guaranteed to thrill science fiction and martial arts fans alike.

Title: 306. Dirty Like an Angel
description: A middle-aged tough cop, George, is trying to help and protect a criminal, Manoni, that he has known since they were both young. He orders his younger colleague and friend, Didier, who has just married to stay with the Manoni's wife and son for surveillance. Meanwhile he starts a sexual affair with Barbara, Didier's young and sexy wife.

Title: 307. Scary Movie
description: A paranoid teenage nerd comes to believe that an escaped lunatic may be hiding in the neighborhood Halloween house of horrors, and slowly starts to descend into madness.

Title: 308. Happy Hell Night
description: A fraternity-hazing prank goes terribly wrong and a psychotic killer is set loose. Now a relentless evil has been unleashed, and the coeds of Winfield College will face the bloody horror of HAPPY HELL NIGHT.

Title: 309. Amor y venganza
description: Young runway model seeks vengeance on ex who forgot about her after achieving overnight international fame, becoming a celebrated film star due to her looks.

Title: 310. 11 Days, 11 Nights 2
description: Sarah, executor of her ex-lover's will, must choose one heir from a wealthy Louisiana family to inherit in 11 days. Complex relationships and secrets emerge as she evaluates each candidate's worthiness.

Title: 311. There's Nothing Out There
description: When a horror film buff tries to warn his friends spending spring break in a house in the woods of impending danger, they scoff at him, that is, until a huge mutant frog starts to pick them up one by one.

Title: 312. Dolly Dearest
description: A toy manufacturer buys the 'Dolly Dearest' factory in Mexico, where the malevolent spirit of Sanzia, a devil child, has taken refuge in one of the porcelain dolls, and eventually takes control of his daughter.

Title: 313. Games of Desire
description: Young wife Florentine, neglected by impotent husband Jake, has affairs watched by his accomplice Dorothy. Jake's voyeurism rekindles his desire for Florentine. Their son exposes Jake's twisted fantasy.

Title: 314. Night Eyes II
description: Security expert Will Griffith has been hired to secure the mansion of South American expatriate Hector Mejenes, upon the insistence of his American wife, Marilyn.

Title: 315. The Indecent Woman
description: A woman with a steady marriage and a little daughter, goes berserk and engages in a game of seduction.

Title: 316. Once a Thief
description: A romantic and action packed story of three best friends, a group of high end art thieves, who come into trouble when a love-triangle forms between them.

Title: 317. Plyontek
description: Plyontek, a boy with problems, is sent to a sanitarium where it appears the patients make the rules.

Title: 318. Mima
description: Mima and her Italian family live in France. When her grandfather is killed, she discovers that they have a long-running family feud with the mafia.

Title: 319. Husbands and Lovers
description: A scriptwriter working in Rome becomes distraught over his beauteous wife and the "arrangement" they have when she discovers S&M with her longtime pianist lover.

Title: 320. Saudagar
description: Two clan chiefs who have maintained a blood feud for decades have to contend with the romance between their respective grandchildren.

Title: 321. A Scene at the Sea
description: The lives of a young, hearing-impaired and gloomy couple are fulfilled after the boy holds interest in surfboarding.

Title: 322. Neon City
description: "Mad Max" clone set in the not-too-distant future about a group of people trying to escape to a safe haven called Neon City after a solar disaster that has decimated the Earth.

Title: 323. Dil Hai Ki Manta Nahin
description: Runaway heiress in search of her beloved falls in love with another man on the way.

Title: 324. The Children Thief
description: In 1925 Paris, the Colonel kidnaps unhappy or abandoned boys, providing them and his wife with comfort and joy in his rich mansion. Then things become complicated when he adopts a girl.

Title: 325. Cover-Up
description: An ex-marine turned journalist battles against time to save lives after uncovering a terrorist plot.

Title: 326. Alligator II: The Mutation
description: A giant alligator makes a city lake his new feeding ground and must be stopped before he breaks out into the surroundings.

Title: 327. Passion's Flower
description: A man returns to his home from prison and finds himself entangled in a poisonous love triangle.

Title: 328. Highway Patrolman
description: Against his father's wishes, Pedro, a naive kid from Mexico City, joins the Federal Highway Patrol. His simple desire to do good rapidly comes into conflict with the reality of police work.

Title: 329. Empire of the Dark
description: A private detective searching for a killer comes across a satanic cult from another dimension, monsters called up from hell and murderous ninja assassins.

Title: 330. Rover Dangerfield
description: A Vegas show dog gets ditched in the sticks and ends up working on a farm.

Title: 331. Jacquot of Nantes
description: A boy growing up in Nantes during World War II around his father's auto shop has a love for puppet shows and cinema and develops it into his own art. Jacques Demy, the artist at the end of his life, reflects on his childhood influences.

Title: 332. The Dark Wind
description: A Navajo police officer is mixed up in drug smuggling and murder on the reservation.

Title: 333. Lesbian Rape: Sweet Honey Juice
description: A mentally unbalanced lab technician who works at university develops a lesbian crush on her new assistant. She is also obsessed with becoming a parent and so hires a man to rape and impregnate her young girlfriend. Then plans to kill him.

Title: 334. Body Chemistry II: The Voice of a Stranger
description: Erotic thriller, as a man is torn between two women and his own violent self, born of child abuse. On one side is his old sweetheart, on the other is a sexy radio psychologist who encourages his violent sexual fits, while simultaneously raising the sexual ante between them.

Title: 335. Lucky Luke
description: Lucky Luke becomes the Sheriff of Daisy Town and runs out all the criminals. Then the Dalton brothers arrive and try to get the Indians to break the peace treaty and attack the town.

Title: 336. The Golden Lotus: Love and Desire
description: Jin-Lian marries her beloved, Simon, but learns he is liaising with another woman, Ping-Er. In a no-holds-barred attempt to win his devotion, the two women embark on a physical and emotional sparring match that only one of them can win.

Title: 337. Saajan
description: A poet (Sanjay Dutt) and his best friend (Salman Khan) fall in love with the same woman (Madhuri Dixit).

Title: 338. The Borrower
description: Aliens punish one of their own by sending him to earth. The alien is very violent, and when the body he occupies is damaged, he is forced to find another.

Title: 339. Madame Bamboo
description: Two prostitutes recall the circumstances the brought them to the brothel.

Title: 340. Manta Manta
description: Proud German owners of Opel Manta's race the streets against VW's and Mercedes. They decide to set up a real race with lots of money involved.

Title: 341. Lamhe
description: Yash Chopra's most cherished film with soul stirring music is a story of moments - moments of passion, of ecstasy and of life changing love.

Title: 342. The Flesh
description: A divorced municipal worker seeks divine fusion through an intense affair with a mysterious woman, but their isolated retreat spirals into obsessive consumption when spiritual union proves impossible.

Title: 343. Erotic Ghost Story II
description: Wu Tung, the lascivious demon of carnal desire, falls for one of his conquests, only to see her destroyed. He demands the girl's village to regularly send him a virgin or face his wrath. One of the girls has his lover's spirit within her.

Title: 344. The Linguini Incident
description: Two disgruntled restaurant employees (David Bowie, Rosanna Arquette) decide to rob their employers (Buck Henry, Andre Gregory).

Title: 345. Atlantis
description: Atmospheric soundtrack follows this compilation of nature footage that focuses on the ocean and various life forms that live, mate and die in it.

Title: 346. Bikini Summer
description: A group of friends are hired to redecorate a beach house while the elderly owners are out of town for the summer. Redecorating is the last thing on their minds, and a wild bikini filled summer is had by all. An imposter-photographer, a bikini designer, an all girl metal-band, and the token environmentalist all join forces in staging a riotous Bikini Contest... much to the consternation of the local D.A., and her loyal cadre of policemen.

Title: 347. Island of Fire
description: A cop goes undercover to infiltrate a deadly prison where a team of mercenaries is being assembled.

Title: 348. Mindwarp
description: In post-apocalyptic 2037, Judy rebels against the AI-ruled utopia where people live in a happy VR simulation. She's exiled to a post-nuclear wasteland where she meets drifter Stover. Mutated cannibals capture them for their leader Seer.

Title: 349. The Pleasure Principle
description: Part relationship drama and part sex comedy follows a middle-aged man who loves women and sex and can't stop cheating. He gets a divorce from his angry wife, but then cheats on his lovers. However, one of them decides to get even.

Title: 350. A Chinese Ghost Story III
description: A 100 years after the events of A Chinese Ghost Story (1987), a Buddhist monk and his clumsy disciple journey through a small town to transport a golden Buddha idol, and end up taking shelter at the haunted Orchid Temple ruins.

Title: 351. Where Sleeping Dogs Lie
description: A murder mystery writer misreads the nervous man he bullies in a spooky Hollywood mansion.

Title: 352. The King of Ads
description: A collection of European T.V. commercials directed by a variety of well-known directors from across Europe and the U.S. Compiled and produced by Jean-Marie Boursicot.

Title: 353. Clearcut
description: A white lawyer finds his values shaken when he is paired with an angry Indigenous activist who insists on kidnapping the head of a logging company to teach him the price of his destruction.

Title: 354. 976-Evil II
description: A seemingly harmless telephone service endows an evil teacher with powers from beyond the grave.

Title: 355. Timebomb
description: Eddy is recognised on TV after rescuing a woman and her baby, and must uncover the truth about his past while evading deadly agents.

Title: 356. Voices from Beyond
description: Rosy Mainardi investigates her father's suspicious death after his spirit returns to guide her, uncovering a family trapped by betrayal, greed, and buried secrets.

Title: 357. One Moonlit Night
description: After many years in prison a man returns to his town of birth. The memories from his childhood, which culminate in the inexplicable murder of a young girl, are portrayed through flashbacks. The man walks through the town, the same way he walked as a boy.

Title: 358. Love
description: Prithvi and Maggie fall in love and decide to get married, but Maggie's mother objects looking at Prithvi's past.

Title: 359. Phool Aur Kaante
description: A young man who despises his father's criminal profession, wants to live a peaceful life away from him but fate has some other plans.

Title: 360. Uncaged
description: Miki and her brother Robby escape their troubled home for Los Angeles. She meets Sharkey, a pimp, becomes drawn to him and works for him. Trapped in his controlling world, Miki seeks a way out.

Title: 361. Godfather
description: Since Anjooran hates women, his sons remain unmarried. However, everything changes when his youngest son, Ramabhadran, falls in love with Malu, whose grandmother is their family's biggest enemy.

Title: 362. The Jackpot!
description: A secret agent uses his professional skills for tracking his family, and faces the unexpected consequences.

Title: 363. The Pistol: The Birth of a Legend
description: Biography of pro basketball player "Pistol" Pete Maravich, who died suddenly in 1988 at age 40 from a heart attack.

Title: 364. My Father the Hero
description: To impress a boy while on vacation with her divorced father, Veronique pretends that her father is her lover.

Title: 365. Prom Night IV: Deliver Us from Evil
description: Four students ditch their high school prom for a party at a summer home, unaware that a psychotic priest is on the loose, determined to punish sinners.

Title: 366. Malina
description: A female writer and her relationships with two different men, one joyous and one introverted.

Title: 367. Basket Case 3
description: Duane recovers from his delusional breakdown to find his freakish basket-bound brother Belial will soon become a father. But not everything is joyous as the once tight knit brothers no longer seem to trust each other.

Title: 368. Breathing Fire
description: Michael, a Vietnam vet with two kids, pulls off a bank heist with his gang, which includes the bank's manager. To ensure the loyalty of everyone involved, Mike makes a special set of keys, so that the hiding place for the loot can only be opened if all the members are present. The bank manager gets cold feet and tries to back out, so Mike and his buddies kill him and his wife, but his daughter gets hold of the key and runs for help to David, one of her father's old friends who also happens to be a Vietnam vet and a former comrade of Michael's. Will David be able to protect his friend's daughter?

Title: 369. Kilukkam
description: A tourist guide in Ooty shelters a mentally unstable woman in return for the reward offered by her relatives. Later, he comes to know that she is in danger from her relatives.

Title: 370. Merci La Vie
description: A lonely teenage girl studying her exams meets a homeless woman and befriend with her.

Title: 371. Rock 'n' Roll High School Forever
description: The students of Ronald Reagan High, lead by their rock 'n' roll band, rebel against school authorities. Doctor Vadar is hired to bring discipline and order.

Title: 372. Sadak
description: A taxi driver with a tragic past sees an opportunity for redemption when he encounters a woman sold into prostitution. Wanting to help her escape, he has to deal with the wrath of the brothel madam.

Title: 373. Turtle Vision
description: Once Yue, being still a young schoolgirl, was subjected to brutal rape on the roof of her own school. Slightly matured, she became a prostitute and began to cruelly avenge all members of the masculine gender, for her sadistic pleasure.

Title: 374. Caged Women
description: American tourist Janet Cooper goes on vacation in a remote South American country. After being arrested by a corrupt policeman and convicted of a trumped-up drug possession charge, Janet is imprisoned in an isolated castle.

Title: 375. On Our Own
description: Siblings who have been dumped into the foster-care system find ways to be on their own, often making mistakes and learning from them along the way.

Title: 376. Prime Target
description: He wanted to be a good cop. The mob wanted him destroyed, so they made everything he loved a prime target.

Title: 377. Class of Nuke 'Em High Part II: Subhumanoid Meltdown
description: When school reporter Roger Smith meets a beautiful subhumanoid named Victoria, they fall in love but becomes determined to save her and the new school from a giant mutant squirrel, Tromie.

Title: 378. Crazy Safari
description: After a plane crash in Africa, a Taoist priest and his companion must recover an ancient Chinese corpse from Xi and his tribe before it becomes a hopping vampire.

Title: 379. The Suspended Step of the Stork
description: A reporter stuck in a border town with an overcrowding of refugees sees a man he believes to be a long lost politician.

Title: 380. Xtro II: The Second Encounter
description: Military scientists discover an alternate dimension and, subsequently, aliens with an appetite for human flesh.

Title: 381. Black Magic Woman
description: The owner of a suburban art gallery searches for someone to perform an exorcism after a witch casts a spell on him.

Title: 382. Scanners III: The Takeover
description: A young female scanner turns from a sweet young thing into a murderous, power-crazed villain after she takes an experimental drug developed by her father. Her brother, who is also a scanner, is the only one powerful enough to stop her.

Title: 383. Delta Force 3: The Killing Game
description: A terrorist places an atomic bomb somewhere in an American metropolis. The U.S. president has no choice but to call in the Delta Force.

Title: 384. Delusion
description: A man who has just embezzled money from his company is driving through the Nevada desert. He picks up a pretty girl and her seemingly goofy boyfriend. The girl is a Las Vegas showgirl and the boyfriend turns out to be a professional killer, and he has no intention of letting the motorist finish the trip.

Title: 385. The Terror Within II
description: In a post-apocalyptic world full of terrifying mutants known as gargoyles, survivors of the last human colony battles against intruding gargoyles a few miles below the Earth's surface.

Title: 386. Dead Women in Lingerie
description: A private detective is hired to catch a serial killer who makes immigrant garment workers his victims.

Title: 387. Saugandh
description: A woman whose entire family was murdered by a cruel landowner, vows that she will get her son and his daughter married someday.

Title: 388. The Loves of Lady Chatterley
description: Lord Chatterley hires again Charles, the former gardener and ex-lover of Joelle, Lady Chatterley. Once reignited, their passion leads to perversion.

Title: 389. Hidden Desire
